title: Component Part 2.3: functional CheckBox + RadioButton (toggle/selected state, radio groupName)
description: DONE (Part 2.3). Functional CheckBox + RadioButton built on the registry-driven extension of the Part-2.1/2.2 infra in packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts (ControlKind + CONTROL_REGISTRY: per-control buildMarks + authorClassBody appended to a shared base class). CheckBox: white indicator box + check_mk tick mark (DefineShape4), boolean 'selected' toggled on click, reflects author selected/label. RadioButton: indicator circle + dot_mk mark, groupName mutual-exclusivity via _root.__radioGroups registry, data/value. Click path uses broadcast onMouseDown + manual point-in-bbox (__inBounds) because the bundled Ruffle build does not dispatch button-mode onPress/onRelease to a registerClass'd movieclip and its hitTest returns false for them (isolated empirically). VERIFICATION: (1) Structural unit tests packages/swf/src/__tests__/component-place.test.ts 'functional CheckBox + RadioButton controls' — each control emits class DoInitAction (DefineFunction2) before registerClass, ExportAssets, skin sprite (DefineShape4 face + DefineEditText label + mark; 3 placements/2 shapes), and selected/groupName/data param delivery. swf suite: 1416 passed (115 files). (2) Ruffle oracle apps/desktop/e2e/component-oracle.spec.ts 'v2 CheckBox + RadioButton runtime oracle' — CheckBox click toggles selected (before red=20000 blue=0; after red=0 blue=20010); RadioButton group: clicking B deselects A (before red=20000; after blue=20038). Full component-oracle suite 6 passed (incl Part 2.1/2.2 unregressed). core suite: 5295 passed, only the 3 pre-existing task-1207 flash8-empty.fla fixture failures (fixture absent in worktree — unrelated). typecheck/build green. docs/13-components.md updated with the Part 2.3 section.
